text: On the ideal male, the wrist hangs just below the crotch and the elbows line up with the navel.
quote: The wrist drops just below the crotch. The elbows are about on a line with the navel.

text: The ideal male is drawn 6 feet tall with 9-inch head units and shoulders at about 5 feet.
quote: The proportions are also given in feet so that you may accurately relate your figure to furniture and interiors.

text: The average real woman has shorter legs and somewhat heavier thighs than the 5 ft 8 in idealized figure.
quote: Actually, of course, the average girl has shorter legs and somewhat heavier thighs.

text: An adult woman is about half a head shorter than an adult man.
quote: a man or a woman (about half a head shorter than you would draw the man)

text: A woman has a smaller rib cage, a wider and deeper pelvis and narrower shoulders than a man.
quote: FEMALE RIB CASE IS SMALLER, PELVIS WIDER AND DEEPER, SHOULDERS NARROWER.

text: A man's larger rib cage gives wider shoulders and narrower hips; a woman's larger pelvis gives a longer waistline, lower buttocks and wider hips.
quote: These differences account for the wider shoulders and narrower hips of the male; the longer waistline, lower buttocks, and wider hips of the female.

text: A woman's arms flare out wider when swinging as she walks, and her thigh bone angles more obliquely.
quote: They also cause the female arms to flare out wider when they are swinging back and forth

text: A woman has a more slender neck and smaller, much more delicate hands than a man.
quote: The jaw is less developed. The neck is more slender. The hands are smaller and much more delicate.

text: A woman's arm muscles are smaller and much less visible, and her waistline is higher.
quote: The muscles of the arms are smaller and much less in evidence. The waistline is higher.

text: A woman's hip bone juts out farther, her buttocks are fuller, rounder and lower, and her thighs flatter and wider.
quote: The greater trochanter of the femur extends out farther; the buttocks are fuller, rounder, and lower. The thighs are flatter and wider.

text: A woman's calf is much less developed, her ankles and wrists smaller, and her feet smaller and more arched.
quote: The calf is much less developed. The ankles and wrists are smaller. The feet are smaller and are arched more.

text: A woman's muscles are generally less prominent and more straplike, except thighs and buttocks, which are proportionately larger and stronger.
quote: The muscles, in general, are less prominent, more straplike—all but those of the thighs and buttocks, which are proportionately larger and stronger in the female.

text: Where bones lie near the surface, a fat body shows dimples or hollows, while a thin or aged body shows the bones protruding.
quote: When the body becomes fat, these spots become dimples or recessions in the surface. In thin or aged figures, these bones protrude.

text: The 'smart' fashionable female figure has slightly mannish contours: shoulders a bit wider with little slope and hips a bit narrower.
quote: The shoulders are drawn a little wider than normal, without much slope, the hips a little narrower.

text: An attractive female ideal has long slender thighs and legs, tapering calves, small knees and small ankles, with legs touching at thigh, knee and ankle when together.
quote: The thighs and legs are made longer and more slender, with tapering calves. When the legs are together, they should touch at the thigh, knee, and ankle.

text: Figures that are large-headed, narrow-shouldered, short-limbed, wide-hipped, short, fat or pudgy read as unattractive, while bony and unusually tall figures still please fashion buyers.
quote: But a figure may be actually bony and unusually tall and still please a fashion editor.

text: An ideal masculine figure shows plenty of bone and muscle, wide shoulders and a height of at least six feet (eight or more heads).
quote: The essence of successful male figure drawing is that it be kept masculine—plenty of bone and muscle.

text: Lean, hard-muscled men are typically those doing hard physical work.
quote: Unfortunately, it is not easy to find these lean-faced, hard-muscled male models. They are usually at harder work.

text: A fat man reads as older; a heavy build on a male character should not be made too young.
quote: If you get into character drawing, you may do a fat fellow—but don't make him too young.

text: Ideal male hands are slightly large, bony and muscular; soft, round hands on a man look wrong.
quote: The male hands should be exaggerated a little in size and in the ideal type look bony and muscular. Soft, round hands on a man simply won't go.

text: A relaxed natural standing pose puts the weight on one leg, turns the torso, tips the head, or leans on something rather than standing rigid.
quote: put the weight on one leg, turn the torso, tip and turn the head, or allow the figure to lean upon or be supported by something.
